This is a screenshot of a form. Locate each of these labelled widgets: menu, search, avatar, name-field, email-field, phone-field, country, notes, cancel, save, help, status. Label each region with the widget's name exactly as given (for example `name-field`).

Give each region's `bbox` as [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] normalised to 0-1000 (0,0 is the top-left corner, 1000,1000 the bottom-right corner, independent of the image's aspect ratio). Answer with JSON only, in this shape: {"text": <the answer>, "regions": [...]}.

message.content: {"regions": [{"bbox": [0, 10, 65, 48], "label": "menu"}, {"bbox": [318, 10, 621, 48], "label": "search"}, {"bbox": [935, 10, 1000, 48], "label": "avatar"}, {"bbox": [131, 151, 200, 426], "label": "name-field"}, {"bbox": [495, 151, 695, 200], "label": "country"}, {"bbox": [131, 218, 426, 267], "label": "email-field"}, {"bbox": [131, 285, 426, 334], "label": "phone-field"}, {"bbox": [131, 352, 695, 561], "label": "notes"}, {"bbox": [551, 602, 643, 642], "label": "cancel"}, {"bbox": [634, 602, 695, 642], "label": "save"}, {"bbox": [0, 952, 55, 991], "label": "help"}, {"bbox": [825, 952, 985, 991], "label": "status"}] , "text": "The form includes fields for name, email, phone, country and notes, as well as a search bar, menu, avatar, help, status and buttons for saving or cancelling."}
